purpose: Prospectively test whether the sign of the as-published USD Impact Score v2 has directional information about the next completed-Friday DXY move. This research protocol does not change production and does not authorize a predictive claim before the formal gate is completed.

predictor.origin_source: immutable as-published strict reproduction bundle for the origin week
predictor.prediction_rule: predict DXY up when score >= 0; predict DXY down when score < 0
predictor.prediction_timestamp_boundary: only after the origin week's successful push-to-main reproduction attestation and before the next completed Friday outcome bundle exists

target.horizon: one completed Friday to the immediately following completed Friday
target.actual_direction_rule: up when return >= 0; down when return < 0

comparators.one_week_dxy_momentum: predict the sign of the immediately preceding as-published DXY weekly move; for the first origin only, use the frozen 2026-08-21 initialization level as the prior level

primary_endpoint.name: one_week_dxy_directional_accuracy
primary_endpoint.primary_inference: preregistered circular-shift null comparison preserving the observed prediction and outcome sequences
primary_endpoint.circular_shift_rule: compare observed accuracy with all 51 non-zero circular shifts of the 52 prediction signs relative to the fixed 52 outcome signs
primary_endpoint.descriptive_interval: two-sided 95% Wilson interval for directional accuracy

conditions: exactly 52 consecutive resolved prospective predictions exist with no backfill
every origin and outcome is bound to its immutable as-published strict reproduction bundle
observed directional accuracy is at least 0.60
circular-shift p-value is less than or equal to 0.05
model accuracy exceeds the better of always-up and one-week DXY momentum accuracy by at least 0.05
meaningful_predictive_evidence_rule.failure_result: No meaningful one-week DXY directional predictive evidence was established under this preregistered test.
meaningful_predictive_evidence_rule.passing_result_boundary: A pass supports only a bounded one-week DXY directional association in this prospective sample; it does not establish trading profitability, causal power, calibration, performance for other assets or durable future accuracy.

secondary_endpoints.name: spearman_score_return_association
secondary_endpoints.definition: Spearman rank correlation between origin score and next-week DXY log return

secondary_endpoints.name: accuracy_lift_over_always_up
secondary_endpoints.definition: model directional accuracy minus always-up accuracy

secondary_endpoints.name: accuracy_lift_over_momentum
secondary_endpoints.definition: model directional accuracy minus one-week DXY momentum accuracy

amendment_policy.cosmetic_clarification_before_first_orig: versioned amendment allowed if it does not change predictor, target, sample, endpoint, comparator or decision rule
amendment_policy.material_change_after_first_origin: requires a new protocol ID and a reset untouched holdout
amendment_policy.implementation_defect_after_outcome_know: report the defect; do not repair, reconstruct or backfill the affected origin under this protocol

limitations: The target is DXY only, not broad dollar performance or another covered asset.
DXY is also one contemporaneous input to Score v2; the one-week horizon prevents direct same-week target leakage but does not make the predictor economically independent of DXY.
A 52-week sample is limited and may not span all macroeconomic regimes.
The test has no transaction costs, position sizing, drawdown, PnL or portfolio objective.
A passing result would remain first-party evidence until independently reproduced or audited.
